title: Serpent Among the Faithful
description: A surreal scene featuring a large emerald green snake coiled around a central woman with dark hair in an updo, its red eye glowing. Groups of identical women in patterned orange, blue and white dresses stand in rows on both sides, flanked by tall green monoliths against a dramatic sky with dripping red and pink liquid forms containing symbols and jewels.
